Tasty, authentic Vietnamese food with good service in a charming ambiance
Dec 2018 • Family
Our party of 4 was looking for some good, tasty Vietnamese food that was authentic and yet wouldn't break the bank. After much research on the web, Quan Bui came up as an interesting option - and we're so glad we went!

The food was great - tasty, honest local food that was unpretentious. We had the chef's recommended salad which was a mix of prawn and squid with lotus stems in a fresh, citrusy dressing with fragrant peanuts and crackers. Our mains were the traditional braised pork with egg (a little on the salty side but still good), the grilled brinjal / aubergine with minced pork and fish sauce and a fried noodle dish with beef and spinach. All were very good and tasty. Dessert was the che (sweet soup) of the day which happened to be lotus seed and the passion fruit custard which was served in a halved passion fruit. Both were great!

The ambiance was lovely - a charming dining area which reminded me of an old bungalow. There were interesting paintings which were life like and added to the charm. The service was also attentive and the manager Loc (pronounced Lop) gave good recommendations when we ordered. All in all an outstanding meal at great value!
